title: Average rating per movie
statementMd:
For every reviewed movie show the title, number of reviews and average rating rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `title`, `reviews`, `avg_rating`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.title, COUNT(*) AS reviews, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON r.movie_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.title;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
